evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates creating a game with name/description; related stories cover inviting/playing, not creation.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from estimator joining (PP-029) and from team-size limit (PP-028); no other story repeats URL-based invitation.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; other item stories address list management (add/edit/delete/select) rather than starting a round via entry.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar theme to PP-031 (estimators see all items) but different actor/role; not a duplicate per QUS guidance.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from re-estimating earlier items (PP-013) and from adding/editing/deleting items; no duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: CRUD-like but not duplicated; PP-007 and PP-008 cover edit/delete separately.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses editing an existing item; import/copy-paste are different mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting a game (PP-020) and deleting an account (PP-024); no duplicate item-deletion story.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-033 which shows estimates only after all have estimated; not a duplicate due to opposite condition/business rule.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from entering an agreed estimate manually (PP-012) and auto-fill when unanimous (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; differs from PP-010 (average) and PP-012 (manual entry) by trigger and behavior.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry is distinct from accepting computed average (PP-010) or auto-fill on unanimity (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation capability is not duplicated; PP-005 is selecting an item, not explicitly re-estimating prior items.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Related to PP-015 but not the same requirement: 'import' vs 'copy/paste' are different mechanisms and imply different functionality.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Not a duplicate of PP-014 because it specifies a different user interaction/ingestion method (copy/paste vs import).

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from viewing/exporting a transcript (PP-017/18/19); browsing is about finding games, not transcript handling.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; exporting transcripts (PP-018/PP-019) are different goals (file output) than viewing.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from CSV export (PP-019) due to different format and intended use; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from HTML export (PP-018) due to different format and processing intent.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; differs from deleting account (PP-024) and deleting items (PP-008) by object and scope.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates account creation; login/change/delete/password reminder are separate requirements.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from password reminder (PP-026) and account creation (PP-021); no duplicate login story.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; separate from account deletion (PP-024) and creation (PP-021).

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting a game (PP-020); different object and consequences.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story covers timezone localization; unique requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; distinct from login/account management stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates deck/scale selection; unique configuration requirement.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Related to inviting estimators (PP-002) but adds a specific capacity constraint; not the same requirement as URL invitation itself.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from moderator invitation (PP-002); different actor and action (joining vs inviting).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates this specific estimator view of the current item; moderator item selection/list stories differ.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar to PP-004 but different role (estimator vs moderator), which can legitimately be separate; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from showing actual estimates (PP-033/PP-036) because it is about status/participation visibility, not values.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; contrasts with PP-009 (show early) and differs from PP-036 (see who gave what during current round) by timing/condition.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Substantially the same requirement as PP-041 (change estimate until draw completed); no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-039 (scroll back through stories/estimates) and PP-036 (current round); focuses on per-estimator history for current story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-033 (reveal timing rule) and PP-032 (status that an estimate was given); this is about mapping estimator to value in current round.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; PP-038 is about auto-reset behavior, not starting the timer.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-037 (starting the timer); adds automatic reset trigger behavior.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; differs from PP-035 (per-estimator prior estimates for current story) and from moderator transcript viewing (PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates card ordering consistency; unique UI/interaction requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 (change estimate until last person selects a card / all shown); same actor and goal with equivalent completion condition.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates participant photo/avatar display; unique personalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from accessibility (PP-047) and browser compatibility (PP-046); standards compliance is a separate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates glossary/definitions; unique documentation/shared-understanding requirement.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; performance story PP-048 is broader and user-facing, while this is a specific technical optimization.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates explicit cross-browser support; distinct from standards/accessibility requirements.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from XHTML/CSS compliance (PP-043) and browser compatibility (PP-046); accessibility is separate.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: No other story states the same general responsiveness requirement; PP-045 is a specific means, not the same requirement statement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates Unicode/language support requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates URL design requirement.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates custom error page requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates anonymized/non-identifiable storage for research; unique privacy/data handling requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates usage metrics/analytics requirement.
